$description: motosh.dev design tokens. Mirrors design-system/variables.css; that file is what the site actually loads.

ink.$description: Headings, primary text, and the dark band itself. Off-black, so a full-bleed dark section never reads as a hole in the page.

ink-2.$description: Body copy and secondary labels. Carries most running text; also the hairline on the dark band.

ink-3.$description: Stepped-back state. Used only where an interactive diagram dims what is not currently relevant.

line.$description: The single hairline. Every border, rule and divider on a light surface is this colour at 1px.

line-faint.$description: A hairline that has been stepped back — the unlit connections in the content-model diagram.

paper.$description: Page background, card surfaces on tinted bands, text on the dark band.

mist.$description: The alternating section band and the navigation pill. Neutral grey, no warmth.

mist-2.$description: Hover state for a tile already sitting on Mist.

sand.$description: The warm band, used exactly twice per page at most: «Про мене» and the result section. Also the selection highlight.

sand-line.$description: Hairline on the Sand band — the neutral hairline disappears against warm ground.

ink-raised.$description: Card hover on the dark band.

ink-raised-2.$description: Active row inside the dark record panel.

accent.$description: The only chromatic mark in the system: the 28px lead of every rule, the live dot, the lit path in a diagram, the cost bar. Rationed on purpose — it means «this one».

bronze.$description: Section eyebrows and field labels. Warm, low-chroma, never used for a surface.

display.$description: Display voice, weight 400 only. The pairing works on aperture and a geometric base, not on weight — nothing in the display face is ever heavier than 400.

sans.$value: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, sans-serif
sans.$description: Grammar of the page: body 400, meta 500, rare 600. Full Cyrillic coverage including ґ, є and the apostrophe.

caps.$description: The meta voice: 500 weight, 0.08em tracking, uppercase. Numbers, statuses, timeline dates.

eyebrow.$description: Bronze section label. Sentence case, never uppercase — it is a name, not a stamp.

display-hero.$description: The only fluid step: from 900px up the hero has to survive 900 → 1600px.

display-xl.$description: Oversized ordinals in the decision log and principle rows.

btn.$description: Buttons. Deliberately not a pill: the pill is reserved for navigation and chips.

tile.$description: The signature single corner. Opens to 24px on hover — the one shape that carries the whole system.

ease-out.$description: Things arriving: reveals, hero stagger, curtain copy.

ease-soft.$description: Things responding to the pointer: hover, radius morph, row nudge.

ease-gate.$description: Things that own the whole screen: the intro curtain and the route morph.

dur-4.$description: Scroll reveal, and the card → full-screen morph.
